events.summary: Rechecked exact 2027 flight dates for all 40 short and full itineraries; updated route assumptions, fare bands, readiness, dependent itinerary copy, and recommendation scores. Greece Ionian now exits through an Athens buffer because PVK has no exact-date itinerary, and Iceland + Ischia + Cilento is explicitly reroute-required because its assumed Jun 10 nonstop does not operate.
$15,000 changed from mandatory-ceiling language to a strongly preferred maximum; all existing itineraries remain visible.
Structured axis rationale, source classes, proxy status, freshness, and confidence were added for every trip.
Added an 11-night, quote-dependent lower-cost alternative while preserving the 12-night canonical plan.
